nom: TATCHA The Texture Tonic AHA Liquid Exfoliating Treatment

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the tonic keeps shine and T-zone oiliness in check and helps with acne, though one describes it as super drying and acne-triggering when used daily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry (often dry-mature) skin describe it as gentle enough for daily use, improving texture and pore appearance without stripping the skin.
segments.combination: One combination-skin reviewer with long-standing acne reports it smooths skin and helps acne scars without drying her out.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is unusually gentle, non-irritating and non-stinging even where other exfoliants failed, while others report rashes, eczema flare-ups, bumpy itchy skin or no benefit at all.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (50s-60s) report smoother texture, smaller-looking pores and firmer, more even-toned skin, though a couple in this group saw no improvement in enlarged pores.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 50s-60s report smoother, firmer, more even-toned skin and general improvement in look of skin over weeks; one 50-something reviewer specifically saw no clearing of nose pores.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not dry out or strip skin and even adds moisture; one reviewer with oily/combo dehydrated skin found it added moisture, but another reports it was so drying she developed flaky skin and rebound acne.
concerns.redness: A small number of sensitive reviewers report rash or eczema-like reactions after use, while others with sensitive skin explicitly say it caused no redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers note no burning, stinging or irritation compared to other toners/acids, but a few describe compromised skin (itchy, bumpy, rash, eczema) after continued use.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fewer or smaller-looking pores after use; two mature reviewers with enlarged nose pores specifically did not see improvement.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal adult acne report fewer breakouts and improved acne scarring; one oily reviewer reports the opposite, developing acne after the product dried her skin and forced use of heavier moisturizers.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report it controls shine and excess oil (one credits niacinamide) without making skin greasy; no dissent on this point among oily reviewers, though one still developed dryness-driven breakouts.

extraits.texte: I have really oily break out prone skin live in a humid climate but this made my skin so dry I had to stop using it and it took 2 weeks of using extreme moisturizing products to get my normal skin back which caused acne of course But just the essence and water cream was not helping because this tonic had dried out my skin so much I had to use moisturizers that were not oil free which caused some acne just to stop the dry flakey skin I was getting from this maybe use this once a week because that was not fun to deal with I asked their beauty advisors and they said it was fine to use every day definitely not for me Gave 2 stars because it does what it says but it is way too drying

extraits.titre: Not my favorite product from Tatcha
extraits.texte: I usually use the ordinary toner so Im used to a stronger acid for toner and this was pleasantly light and definitely didnt burn at all but after two weeks of use and the only change in my skin care routine I started to notice bumpy itchy skin all over my face I stopped using this and within 3 days my face was feeling much better Very bummed because one this is pricey but also it seemed like a gentler alternative to strong astringent toners Unfortunately doesnt work for my skin which usually is not sensitive to most products I wont be buying this again

As much as I wanted to love this product like I do all other Tatcha products sadly it gives me rash and I break out in eczema I have sensitive skin so maybe its just too abrasive for me Thankfully I have the indigo cleansing balm calming cream and overnight repair that I layer on and clears the rash right up in just a couple of days

I received a couple of samples of the Texture Tonic a year ago when I was stocking up on SPF during the BF amp CM sales Once I received it I threw it in my travel bag to have for a future trip or on a rainy day A little backstory on my skin I have always had very oily skin that in more recent years has become oilycombodehydrated I have struggled with hormonal acne since I was in my mid 20's and I am now in my early 30's I recently stopped taking oral medication for my hormonal acne which I had been taking for about four years Even though the medication was doing wonders for my skin stopped my hormonal acne and even calmed my oily skin down I stopped taking it because there was no end sight to using it and I didn't want to take a medication long-term For the past few months I have been using a hormonal cream and Tretinoin that I got from my derm The Tret is starting to really dry my skin out as we get into the colder months and is starting to cause my skin to get overly dry and break out more because of it So I finally just got around to trying my two sample packets of the Texture Tonic a few weeks ago I was honestly a little skeptical and worried this would over sensitize my skin due to my topical medications or make my acne worse as any little change does However I fell in love at one swipe The tonic really helped to add some moisture back into my skin while making it feel clean but not overly clean It absorbed super quickly and then I went about my skin regimen as normal th

This is one of the only products that has been a saving grace to my skin As an oily girl with lots of acne scaring and also having sensitive skin and eczema I could never find a product that would benefit all my concerns yet be right for my skin-type and give me results until I tried this products Yes I know it's pricy but you are paying for the results this is an absolute MUST

I have dry mature skin so I thought it would be for me Im glad I gave it a try because it has become essential to my skin care routine My skin looks so much better My pores arent as big and it helps with the overall texture Love this product because it is gentle enough for my dry skin

I have very sensitive skin but needed some kind of exfoliation This is the perfect thing for me I can use it daily but it doesn't irritate my skin The only downside is the smell It's quite strong initially but it does go away pretty quickly Very medicinal smelling
